info.name: Enterprise OPA REST Batch Compile API

params.name: path
params.description: The path separator is used to access values inside object and array documents. If the path indexes into an array, the server will attempt to convert the array index to an integer. If the path element cannot be converted to an integer, the server will respond with 404.

params.name: pretty
params.description: If parameter is `true`, response will formatted for humans.

params.name: explain
params.description: Return query explanation in addition to result.

params.name: metrics
params.description: Return query performance metrics in addition to result.

params.name: instrument
params.description: Instrument query evaluation and return a superset of performance metrics in addition to result.
